products.title: Ascend Mat 4mm
products.body_html: A performance-focused yoga mat made from 100% natural rubber, designed for dynamic flows and serious practice. Usable on both sides for versatility and control, it provides dependable grip and stability so you can transition smoothly between poses, stay supported through intense sequences, and practise with confidence at a higher level.

products.title: Mastery Mat 4mm
products.body_html: From steady poses to sweaty flows, the Mastery Mat gives you the grip, cushioning, and durability to show up fully every session—for years.

products.title: Away Travel Mat 1.5mm
products.body_html: A lightweight, foldable yoga mat designed for movement on the go without sacrificing grip or stability. Compact enough to fit into your suitcase yet equally grippy as a full-sized mat, it helps you maintain your practice anywhere, move with confidence, and stay grounded whether at home, in the studio, or while travelling.

products.title: Dual Flow Bundle
products.body_html: Two Mastery Mats so you and a partner can practice together with comfort and grip.

products.title: Travel Flow Bundle
products.body_html: Two Away Mats that are lightweight, foldable, and easy to pack for practice anywhere.

products.title: Complete Flow Bundle
products.body_html: One Mastery Mat and one Away Travel Mat, giving you the perfect balance of home stability and travel-ready freedom.

products.title: Elevate Flow Bundle
products.body_html: Two Ascend Mats built for performance and balance. Ideal for couples or advanced practitioners who want to rise higher together.

products.title: Mastery Journey Bundle
products.body_html: Pair the SGS-certified natural rubber yoga mat with eco-friendly twill fabric mat bag. Carry all your practice essentials with ease.
